description:
Retrieve a single transcription

Returns the full transcript of a single page along with its source citation. Mirrors `/transcripties/toon/<id>`. AI-generated summaries are deliberately not returned by this endpoint.
name: show_transcription

archive_number.description: Archive number (archieftoegang) information for a transcription.

nr.description: Archive number as used by the source institution.

url.description: External URL describing the archive on the source institution's website.

inventory_number.description: Inventory number information for a transcription.

page.description: Page number with leading zeros stripped.

project.description: Source project that produced the transcription, e.g. `transkribus`, `globalise`, `mibudera`.

source_archive.description: Source archive holding the transcribed page.

archive_code.description: openarch archive code (matches the codes used elsewhere in this API).

name.description: Localised name of the source archive.

source_url.description: Direct link to the scan or transcription on the source archive's website.

title: Show Transcription
